generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details

As per Karnataka State Government order No. LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and GO. No. PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted welfare fund

The tenderer shall obtain the workdone certificate of single similar nature of workdone certificate 50% of amount put to tender in the prescribed format from the competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of Bids for physical verification.
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason
Tenderer shall note that the tenderers those found Eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers (ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation.
All materials required for this work, shall be procured by the Tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities, at his own cost before use on the work.

All the items includes with all Leads and Lifts, Loading and Unloading,Cost of materials, Labour, HOM of machineries as per Standard specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work and other incidental items which are necessary for the successful completion of the work.
The Project Completion Period is 03 Months including rainy season

3.6Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity ( AxNx2.5-B ) A Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (Updated 2026-27 price level ) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited 1/12years. B Value, price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next. 3/12 years from the probable date of award of this contract.

The tenderer shall submit the single workdone certificate of similar nature work of 50% of amount put to tender (for past 5 years in any one single year) in the prescribed format from the competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of Bids for physical verification.
The defect liability period is 1 year from the date of complication of work failing which action will be taken as per tender condition
